prompt: Measured from its base to its summit rather than from sea level, what is the tallest mountain on Earth?
answer_text: Mauna Kea in Hawaii is the tallest mountain on Earth when measured from its base on the ocean floor to its summit. It stands over 10,000 meters (about 33,500 feet) tall, exceeding Mount Everest’s height above sea level.
